Author: pyreymo
Name: Event Horizon
Changelog:
- Added a pop-out player preview window, available from the preview panel or `/eh preview`.
- Added in-world preview helpers: hover or select a preview player to draw a direction arrow from your character, and selected preview players now get an orange world highlight.
- Improved preview selection so the selected player remains visible while you inspect their keep-rule and budget state.
- Refined the settings preview area and reorganized culling, preview, settings, and config UI code into clearer modules.
Description: Cull distant or irrelevant world objects around your character. Use /eventhorizon or /eh to open settings.
